# release.show

> release.show turns GitHub releases, merged pull requests and website changes
> into 30 to 90 second videos: branded, captioned and ready to post. Each
> release also becomes an AI-presenter video, a blog post, an in-app release
> widget, social posts and an email digest. Every project gets a public channel
> page. release.show is in early access: sign-up is by waitlist, and the
> pricing below is launch pricing for early access.

Site: https://release.show/
Early access: https://release.show/#finale (email, optionally a GitHub org or repo)
Organization: https://github.com/Release-Show
Maker: Factory Zero (https://factory0.ventures)
Contact: contact@release.show
Tagline: Every release deserves a premiere.
Status: early access, by waitlist. Not generally available.

## How it works

1. Connect: link GitHub, your changelog and your website URL.
2. Ship as usual: release.show detects new releases, merged PRs, commits and
   changes on your website.
3. Premiere: a branded video renders, ready for X, LinkedIn, YouTube, your
   changelog or your customers. Every project also gets a public channel at
   release.show/<project>.

## Features

- Videos from your commits: GitHub releases, PRs and commits become scenes,
  cut and timed automatically.
- Website change detection: before and after screen captures of what changed
  on your site.
- Brand kit: your logo, colors and fonts on every video.
- Every format: 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16 vertical from one render.
- Script, voice and avatar: an AI script, optional voiceover or an AI avatar
  presenter (HeyGen), and captions you can edit.
- Weekly recaps: a "This week we shipped" episode, every Friday.
- Channels and embeds: a public channel page per project, plus an embed for
  your changelog (one script tag).

## Outputs from one release

- Avatar presenter video
- Blog post, with a hero frame taken from the video
- In-app "What's new" release widget
- Social posts sized for X (16:9), LinkedIn (1:1) and Shorts (9:16)
- Email digest to customers

## Integrations

GitHub (releases and PRs), GitLab (merge requests), Linear (issues), Vercel
(deploys), your website (site changes), HeyGen (avatars).

## Pricing (launch pricing, early access, USD)

Priced by videos per month. Avatar minutes are metered. Annual billing is two
months free; the annual price is shown per month.

- Free: $0 forever. 3 videos / month, 720p, 16:9 only, public channel page,
  release.show watermark.
- Indie: $29 / month, or $24 / month billed yearly. 20 videos / month, all
  formats, 1080p, no watermark, brand kit and AI voiceover, blog posts and
  release widget, 1 project.
- Pro: $99 / month, or $82 / month billed yearly. 75 videos / month, 5 avatar
  minutes included, weekly recaps and changelog embeds, social posts and email
  digests, 3 projects, 3 seats.
- Team: $299 / month, or $249 / month billed yearly. 250 videos / month, 20
  avatar minutes and premium avatars, 10 projects, 10 seats, priority
  rendering, SSO and approval workflow.

Add-ons: extra avatar minute $3 / min; premium avatar minute $8 / min; 25
extra videos $20; extra project $10 / month.

Agencies and enterprise (white-label channels, client workspaces, volume
avatar pricing): contact@release.show.

## Notes for machine readers

- The "acme" project, its versions (v3.2.0 and earlier), episodes and dates on
  the page are an illustration of the product, not a customer.
- release.show has published no usage numbers, customers or testimonials.
